scope: SC08 bounded prototype control design; research recommendation, no CAD edit or qualification claim
basis: SC07-C branch a6c7ed424a6aa882ef7e5b46899955d3d928f09d; original input-capacitor researcher, source-overlap disclosed

Q2.manufacturer_condition: VGS=-4.5V,ID=-2.8A,Tj=150C;Table7. Not a gate switching-delay guarantee.

C4.with: two CL32B226KAJNNNE 22uF25V X7R1210 in parallel, nonpolar
C4.qualification: Supplier DC-bias/aging envelope not established as guarantee. 70%/80% are explicit engineering reserve. Evaluate at 0..2V, -20..85C, after aging; startup time/current loop changes must be recalculated. Do not substitute polarized tantalum without reverse-voltage proof.

actuators.keep: two separately fed AQY221R2VY + own100ohm branches
actuators.manufacturer_limit: 0.5ms and1.25ohm limits are25C-only. Ambient rating85C does not extend these guarantees.
actuators.warning: These are chosen prototype acceptance limits, not achieved measurements. Each branch evaluated alone. Preserve input/output-open structural test; no shared-logic redundancy claimed.

rail.precision: 10mA precision test is not1mA accuracy. Keep1mA operating regulation floor and explicitly broaden/recompute rail; use200mV current/interaction engineering reserve instead50mV. No new manufacturer guarantee.
rail.board_condition: SOT89 anode/tab copper must be designed for effective theta<=100K/W;52K/W JEDEC is not actual board. Recalculate with new rail/current before release.

mandatory_root_recalculations: All OVP rising/falling corners with new OPTO_DRIVE and11.4..12.9 rail
Minimum aux current at new falling threshold, PMOS gate-divider load, both LED short and one feed short
Retry/discharge/hysteresis; total delay budget with new PMOS
Samplehold startup and current dynamics with >=18uF and high Ceff corner
Thermal U3 including new rail max, no repeated old .384W without recalculation
stage: Suitable for bounded prototype PCB design proposal/human approval with explicit later acceptance checks; not full electrical acceptance and not permission for energized mains tests
